display.purpose: Restrained Bodoni Moda home heading above the folio; 26–32px responsive mobile scale.

headline.purpose: Main section headings with local content-driven adjustments.

title.purpose: Smaller headings; journal, pricing and photograph titles have documented local sizes.

body.purpose: Light reading and supporting copy, bounded to a comfortable measure.

article-body.purpose: Longer reading with more generous leading.

label.purpose: Primary button labels; compact navigation and metadata use smaller local sizes.

brand.purpose: Outlined Bodoni Moda MA plus full name and Geologica Photography descriptor. Responsive SVG lockup; narrow wordmark at360px.

shadows.name: mobile-enquiry
shadows.purpose: Separates the fixed mobile enquiry action from scrolling photography; not a card treatment.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Easing for the user-directed folio reveal.

motion.name: folio-unfold
motion.purpose: Clip inset from 0 1.5% 0 0 to 0 and brightness from .94 to 1 after a scene changes.

motion.name: button-background
motion.purpose: Primary, light and outline button background transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, all animations and transitions are removed and smooth scrolling becomes automatic.

motion.name: rail-scroll
motion.purpose: Manual previous/next controls scroll one print plus its gap. Under reduced-motion preferences the behavior is instant.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The main enquiry and continuation action; small header instances reduce to 44px minimum height.

components.name: Light button
components.description: A paper action on a charcoal field, including the featured collection.

components.name: Outline button
components.description: A secondary action with the same compact rectangular silhouette.

components.name: Text field
components.description: Visible labels, square transparent fields, shared focus and explicit invalid and disabled states.

components.name: Desktop navigation
components.description: Quiet normal-case links; underline marks the current page and hover. The full site changes to a dialog at 900px.

components.name: Brand logo
components.description: Outlined serif MA and full-name logo. A name-only version preserves descriptor legibility on narrow screens.

narrative.overview: An open photographic folio in warm cream and dark charcoal. The user explicitly restored this palette and asked to regain an elegant, premium feel. Bodoni Moda provides the full-name wordmark and editorial headings; compact Geologica keeps reading, navigation and forms clear. Unequal photographs, precise captions and practical margins remain the defining layout.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream and ivory surfaces with dark grey actions and sections.
Refined upright serif display type paired with a restrained sans serif UI.
Unequal image groupings and subject-aware crops.
Flat square controls, thin warm-grey rules and visible underlined links.
Explicit photographic preview choices, manual photo browsing and brief, optional motion.

rules.name: The Tonal Field Rule
rules.body: Separate major content with cream, ivory and charcoal fields. Keep recurring content and pricing bands flat.

rules.name: The Two Role Rule
rules.body: Use the serif for editorial voice and the sans serif for reading and operation. Keep headings restrained so photography leads.

rules.name: The Flat Content Rule
rules.body: Reserve the existing shadow for the floating mobile enquiry action; ordinary panels, journal items and pricing remain flat.

dos: Do use the cream and charcoal fields, refined Bodoni Moda headings, compact Geologica UI and visible underlined links.
Do preserve the subject when a photograph is cropped, and retain native ratios in the gallery and contained images in the viewer.
Do keep photographic choices and rail controls explicit, make scene changes user-triggered and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do keep selected, focus, invalid, disabled and loading states distinguishable through more than copy alone.
Do preserve the full-name identity, clear MA favicon and unobtrusive fictional-brand and enquiry-demo disclosures.
Do edit the maintained stylesheet and generator when extending the site; the served CSS and HTML are generated outputs, and the public export excludes development contracts.
donts: Don't introduce oversized or italic display typography, another display family, or a boxed monogram in the header.
Don't turn the native gallery photographs into equal-height crops or the collection bands into generic floating cards.
Don't remove visible focus, image credits, current navigation states or the enquiry preview's operating limits.
Don't promote hidden legacy eyebrow markup, decorative numbering or text-arrow characters into new component conventions.
